label: Theorized social behavior through theatrical staging, frontstage performances, and face preservation
description: Erving Goffman formulated and introduced the concept of "Dramaturgical Self & Face-Work", which became a seminal contribution in symbolic-interactionism philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in symbolic-interactionism.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Erving Goffman's canonical writings.

label: Goffman's microsociological rituals complemented Bourdieu's embodied habitus
description: Pierre Bourdieu synthesized Erving Goffman's framework with contrasting philosophical traditions to produce a novel unified philosophical system.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Erving Goffman's perspective to Pierre Bourdieu's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis across history into the Contemporary & Post-Structural.
